text:
Cass: quick life update — two small things: 1) just accepted an offer to be Director of Product 🎉 (still pinching myself) 2) we adopted a golden retriever rescue yesterday! very sleepy and very affectionate. thinking of bringing the pup by the SF office for a really low-key hello in a week. any name suggestions? also... snacks? :dog: :confetti_ball:
Ming: omg congrats!!! huge news on both counts. we'd love to meet the pup. count me in for snacks. :tada:
Naomi: Director!! that is amazing, Cass. proud of you. for names — how about "Mochi", "Ripley", "Sunny"?
Priya: LOVE Sunny. or "Biscuit". also quick Q — do you want a weekday lunch or after-work? I can coordinate a sign-up.
Ravi: congrats Cass! i can bring puppy-safe treats and some chew toys. also can we get a tiny banner? :smile:
Alex: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/party-dog-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA (for celebration)
Cass: thanks y'all!! weekday lunch probably easiest. here's a quick RSVP list — copy/paste to add your name:
```
RSVP - Puppy meet & greet (Cass's pup)
Date: Tue, May 7
Time: 12:15pm
Location: SF lounge
Attendees:
- Cass (host)
```
Ming: added — Ming (will bring cookies)
Naomi: Naomi (bringing water bowls + mat)
Priya: Priya (coordinating sign-up sheet)
Ravi: Ravi (bringing treats)
Alex: Alex (bringing tiny banner)
Cass: amazing, thank you! also small ask: if anyone wants to drop by earlier to help set up we can use a hand starting at 11:45.
deploy-bot: Reminder: office fire-drill training on Tue at 11:30 — please be aware when planning visits.
Priya: noted — we'll stagger setup to avoid clash with the drill.
Ming: poll for names? :point_down:
Naomi: ::poll:: Sunny / Biscuit / Ripley / Mochi — vote!
Cass: you all are the best. happy to take any more name recs in DMs. :heart:
